scope: Isolated hosted-playtest preparation; no hosted/rendered/user-test result implied
status_meaning: not_run means a required acceptance check, not a known failure

checks.title: Two-tester state and feedback isolation
Coherent goal correction and retained shot
Correction persistence and selected-card non-resurrection
Free complete judge evaluation through cutoff
No credentials/admin/private feedback/debug exposure
Purpose/scope/next action understood at entry
One-action timed evidence and readable revision diff
Analyst sequence, windows, revisions and denominators
Phone reflow and full translation access
Tablet and desktop retain shared order/context
Logical keyboard order and unobscured focus
Meaningful screen-reader status without poll chatter
Contrast and non-color-only status
44px product touch target and no hover dependency
Truthful outage/expiry/uncertain-submit recovery
Own-session New match versus fact-preserving rewind
Optional consent-aware private persistent feedback
Cold judge completes essential guided flow
Truthful historical SDK and deterministic-fact claims
Presentation depth/language preserve factual state
Accessible code entry and truthful expiry
No unrequested autoplay or distracting auto-advance

boundaries.touch_target_44px: Product usability target; WCAG 2.2 AA minimum is 24px or an applicable exception
boundaries.time_goals: Hypotheses for playtest measurement, not observed performance
boundaries.benchmark_sources: Official descriptions inspected; not firsthand product usability testing
boundaries.production_readiness: Not established by these design documents or local unit tests
boundaries.public_deployment: Not performed or approved by this document
